title: Communicate-backed bidirectional Git batch transport
failure_signature: A manual cat-file batch deadlocked because the parent filled stdin before draining a large stdout stream.
candidate_workaround: Use subprocess communicate semantics to drain input and output concurrently, then parse the complete byte stream deterministically.
recurrence_guard: Never implement high-volume bidirectional subprocess exchange as write-all then read-all on bounded pipes.
rollback: Retain all timeout and failed-witness evidence, restore single-object reads if batch parsing changes any digest, and compare the same full manifest.
scope_boundary: Subprocess transport only; all manifest entries and validation gates remain unchanged.
